title: Resolution: The Anomaly Explained
description: The last step is not destruction but understanding. An anomaly measured completely, how it scales, where it breaks the law and by exactly how much, can be renormalised: absorbed into a deeper law that explains it. It was never abnormal, only unexplained. Unlocks the Resolved Anomaly.

puzzle.goal: A quantity G measured at energy scale μ seems to break the scaling a dimensionless theory should have. The breaking is absorbed by letting the coupling g run with μ at the rate β(g) = μ dg/dμ, and by giving each of the n fields in G an extra, anomalous scaling γ. Write the condition that makes the physics independent of the arbitrary scale μ.
puzzle.name: Callan–Symanzik equation (the anomalous dimension)
puzzle.form: μ * pd ( G , μ ) + β * pd ( G , g ) + n * γ * G
puzzle.ask: At a fixed point β = 0, and G then scales as μ^{−nγ}: the anomaly is just a power law. With n fields of anomalous dimension γ, find G(rμ)/G(μ) for a change of scale by r.
puzzle.method: The bare G does not depend on μ; the renormalised one differs from it by a factor Z^{n/2}. Differentiate in μ with the chain rule through g.
